rules.sourceCode: Identifies a question imported before; must not repeat within the file.
rules.type: Single choice, Multiple choice, Short answer, Cloze, True / False, Matching, Essay or Question set.
rules.content: The question text; on a Question set row, the shared passage; a Cloze question marks its blanks as [[b1]], [[b2]]. Write formulas in LaTeX.
rules.points: Question points, a number greater than 0 (0.75 or 0,75). Leave empty for the default 1; Cloze takes the sum of its blank points, True / False takes the Scoring column.
rules.options: One item per line in the cell, as “A. text”: Choice options (up to 10), the statements of a True / False question (a., b., … up to 8) or the left-hand items of a Matching question (1., 2., …).
rules.matchRight: Matching only: the right-hand choices, one per line (A. …); there may be more choices than left-hand items.
rules.correctAnswer: Choice: letter of the correct option (A; several answers A, C). Short answer: one accepted answer per line, the first is the standard answer. Cloze: one line per blank, “b1 = answer 1 | answer 2”. True / False: T or F per statement (T, F, T). Matching: one line per pair, “1 = A”. Essay: a sample answer (optional). Leave empty on a Question set row.
rules.scoring: Multiple choice: ALL_OR_NOTHING or PARTIAL. True / False: PER_STATEMENT: 0.25 / 0.25 or COUNT_TABLE: 0.1 / 0.25 / 0.5 / 1. Cloze: one line per blank, “b1 = 1” (points of each blank). Matching: ONCE (each choice used once) or REUSE (a choice can be reused).
rules.inputHint: Short answer: the input hint shown to learners, optional.
rules.gradingGuide: Essay: the grading guide. Leave empty and the question stays Draft until one is added.
rules.rubric: Essay questions only, optional: write each criterion as “Description: points”, separated by ; or a new line (for example Opening: 0.25; Body: 1). If you add criteria, the question points equal the criteria total.
rules.subject: Subject name or code from the catalog. Child questions left empty take the Question set row's value.
rules.difficulty: Recognition, Comprehension, Application or High application.
rules.taskType: Name or code of a task type in the catalog.
rules.knowledge: MAPID at Knowledge level; several codes separated by commas, the first one is the primary knowledge. If empty the row can still be imported; add knowledge later (missing knowledge is only a warning and does not block Ready).
rules.tags: Tag names or codes separated by commas. Tags not in the catalog are skipped.
rules.setCode: A Question set row and its child questions share the same set code.
rules.keepOptionOrder: Only for single-answer and multiple-answer questions, optional: Yes or No (also x or empty, TRUE/FALSE, 1/0). Empty means the options are still shuffled. Ignored on other types.

ANSWER_INVALID.fix: {type, select, MULTIPLE_CHOICE {Write the letters of the correct options separated by commas, for example A, C.} TRUE_FALSE {Write T or F for each statement that has text, separated by commas, for example T, F, T.} CLOZE {One line per blank as “b1 = answer 1 | answer 2”; the blank code must appear in the content as [[b1]].} MATCHING {One line “1 = A” per pair, linking a left item to an existing right choice; one pair per left item, and each choice only once unless Scoring is REUSE.} SHORT_ANSWER {At most 20 answers, one per line.} other {Write one letter from A to J of an option that has text.}}

DUPLICATE_IN_FILE.fix: Give each question its own source code; delete the repeated row or change the code.

SET_CODE_REPEATED.message: Set code {value} is already used by the question set in row {row, number}

SET_NO_CHILDREN.message: Question set {value} has no valid child questions

KNOWLEDGE_MISSING.fix: Adding knowledge is recommended; without it there is only a warning and Ready is not blocked.

TAG_UNKNOWN.message: Tag “{value}” is not in the catalog and will be skipped
TAG_UNKNOWN.fix: Add the tag in Catalog if you need it.

RUBRIC_INVALID.message: Rubric criterion “{value}” has no points or invalid points
RUBRIC_INVALID.fix: Write each criterion as “Description: points” with points greater than 0, separated by ;.

GRADING_GUIDE_MISSING.message: The essay question has no grading guide
GRADING_GUIDE_MISSING.fix: The question is still imported as Draft; add a grading guide before marking it Ready.

POINTS_INVALID.fix: Enter points as a number greater than 0, for example 1 or 0.75.

TASK_TYPE_UNKNOWN.message: The task type “{value}” is not in the catalog
TASK_TYPE_UNKNOWN.fix: Use the name or code of an active task type, or leave it empty.

SCORING_INVALID.fix: {type, select, MULTIPLE_CHOICE {Write ALL_OR_NOTHING or PARTIAL.} TRUE_FALSE {Write “PER_STATEMENT: 0.25 / 0.25” (adds up to the question points) or “COUNT_TABLE: 0.1 / 0.25 / 0.5 / 1” (not decreasing, last value equals the question points), one value per statement.} CLOZE {One line “b1 = 0.5” per blank, with a blank code from the content and points greater than 0.} MATCHING {Write REUSE or ONCE.} other {Check the Scoring column.}}

ANSWER_MISSING.fix: The question is still imported as a Draft; add the answers before marking it Ready.

CLOZE_MARKER_INVALID.message: A blank marker in the content is repeated or there are more than {max, number} blanks

SET_CHILD_TYPE_INVALID.message: The type “{value}” cannot be a child of a Question set
SET_CHILD_TYPE_INVALID.fix: Import Cloze as a standalone question, without a Set code.

ENTRY_DUPLICATE.fix: Write each label or blank code once per column; delete the repeated line or change the label.

OPTIONS_MISSING.fix: Fill the Options column, one option per line like “A. text”.

KNOWLEDGE_AMBIGUOUS.message: Knowledge code {value} matches several nodes in the {subject} knowledge structure
KNOWLEDGE_AMBIGUOUS.fix: Use the full code so it matches exactly one node.

CELL_SYNTAX.message: The cell in column {column} has invalid syntax
CELL_SYNTAX.fix: Write the cell following the rules of this column in the template columns table.

CLOZE_MARKER_MISMATCH.message: The blank markers in the content do not match the answers
CLOZE_MARKER_MISMATCH.fix: Each [[b1]] marker in the content needs exactly one “b1 = answer” line and the other way round.

BLANK_UNKNOWN.message: Blank {value} is not in the content

SET_CHILD_INVALID.message: The set has an invalid child question, so the whole set is not imported

CHILD_TYPE_NOT_ALLOWED.message: This question type cannot be a child question

SAVE_VALIDATION.message: This row failed the checks made when saving

IMPORT_SOURCE_TYPE_MISMATCH.fix: Change the source code, or use the type of the existing question.
